import Mathlib.RingTheory.Invariant.Basic
import AlgebraicJacobian.Descent.GaloisQuotientGlue

/-!
# Stable opens on affine Galois quotient charts

Ported from the sibling Algebraic Jacobian project
(`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.GaloisDescent.InvariantQuotientOpen`).

Let `L/K` be a finite extension, let `X` carry a semilinear `Gal(L/K)`-action,
and let `U` be a stable affine open of `X`.  The affine quotient chart is
`Spec (Γ(U)^Gal(L/K))`.  If `V ≤ U` is stable, the invariant norm construction
of `GaloisQuotientGlue` covers `V` by basic opens `D(N)` for invariant sections
`N ∈ Γ(U)`.

This file constructs the corresponding open of the quotient chart as the union
of the basic opens cut out by those same elements in `Γ(U)^Gal(L/K)`.  Its main
result is the exact saturation identity

`stableAffineQuotientMap ⁻¹(V/Gal(L/K)) = U.ι ⁻¹(V)`.

The affine quotient map is surjective, so this open is also exactly the image of
`V` and the image is open.  Thus stable overlaps already determine honest opens
on the affine quotient charts.  Constructing and gluing the resulting overlap
isomorphisms is a separate step.

## Main declarations

* `SemilinearAction.affineQuotientMap` is the canonical map
  `Spec A ⟶ Spec (A^Gal(L/K))`.
* `SemilinearGalAction.quotientOpenOfStableSubopen` is the quotient-chart open
  generated by invariant basic opens contained in `V`.
* `SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMap` is the quotient map on a stable
  affine chart.
* `SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMap_preimage_quotientOpen` proves the
  saturation identity above.
* `SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMap_image_stableSubopen` identifies
  the constructed open with the actual image of the stable subopen.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent

namespace SemilinearAction

variable (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
variable (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra K A] [Algebra L A] [IsScalarTower K L A]
variable [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) A] [IsSemilinear K L A]

/-- The canonical affine quotient map `Spec A ⟶ Spec (A^Gal(L/K))`, induced by
the inclusion of the invariant subalgebra. -/
noncomputable def affineQuotientMap :
    Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)) :=
  Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (invariantsSubalgebra K L A).val)

/-- The affine quotient map is surjective on points for a finite Galois-automorphism
group.  The inclusion `A^Gal(L/K) ⟶ A` is integral because every element satisfies
its orbit polynomial, so lying over applies.

Only finiteness of the automorphism group is used; no `IsGalois K L` instance is
needed for this topological conclusion. -/
theorem affineQuotientMap_surjective [FiniteDimensional K L] :
    Function.Surjective (affineQuotientMap K L A).base := by
  let I := invariantsSubalgebra K L A
  letI : SMulCommClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) I A :=
    ⟨fun γ n a => by
      change γ • ((n : A) * a) = (n : A) * (γ • a)
      rw [smul_mul', n.2 γ]⟩
  letI : Algebra.IsInvariant I A (L ≃ₐ[K] L) :=
    ⟨fun a ha => ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  letI := Algebra.IsInvariant.isIntegral I A (L ≃ₐ[K] L)
  change Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap I A))
  exact Algebra.IsIntegral.comap_surjective I A

end SemilinearAction

namespace SemilinearGalAction

variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
variable {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
variable (ρ : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) {U : X.Opens} (hU : ρ.IsStableOpen U)

/-- The open of the affine quotient chart generated by invariant basic opens
`D(N) ≤ V`.  Each index supplies the invariant element
`⟨N, hN⟩ : Γ(U)^Gal(L/K)` cutting out the corresponding quotient-side basic open. -/
noncomputable def quotientOpenOfStableSubopen (V : X.Opens) :
    letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
    letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
    letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
    letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
    letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
    (Spec (CommRingCat.of
      (SemilinearAction.invariantsSubalgebra K L Γ(X, U)))).Opens := by
  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
  letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
  letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
  exact ⨆ i : InvariantBasicOpenIndex ρ hU V,
    PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
      (⟨i.1, i.2.1⟩ : SemilinearAction.invariantsSubalgebra K L Γ(X, U))

/-- The canonical quotient map from a stable affine chart to the spectrum of
the invariant subalgebra of its section ring. -/
noncomputable def stableAffineQuotientMap (hUa : IsAffineOpen U) :
    letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
    letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
    letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
    letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
    letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
    U.toScheme ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of
      (SemilinearAction.invariantsSubalgebra K L Γ(X, U))) := by
  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
  letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
  letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
  exact hUa.isoSpec.hom ≫ SemilinearAction.affineQuotientMap K L Γ(X, U)

/-- **A stable subopen is the pullback of an open on the affine quotient chart.**

The quotient-side open is the union of basic opens defined by invariant sections
whose source-side basic opens lie in `V`.  The invariant-basic-open covering
theorem identifies their source-side union with `V`; functoriality of basic opens
under `Spec` then gives the claimed equality. -/
theorem stableAffineQuotientMap_preimage_quotientOpen [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (hUa : IsAffineOpen U) {V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (hV : ρ.IsStableOpen V) :
    letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
    letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
    letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
    letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
    letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
    (stableAffineQuotientMap ρ hU hUa) ⁻¹ᵁ quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ hU V =
      U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V := by
  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
  letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
  letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
  rw [stableAffineQuotientMap, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage,
    quotientOpenOfStableSubopen, Scheme.Hom.preimage_iSup,
    Scheme.Hom.preimage_iSup]
  simp only [SemilinearAction.affineQuotientMap]
  rw [hUa.isoSpec_hom]
  calc
    (⨆ i : InvariantBasicOpenIndex ρ hU V,
        U.toSpecΓ ⁻¹ᵁ
          (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (i.1 : Γ(X, U)) :
            (Spec (CommRingCat.of Γ(X, U))).Opens))
        = ⨆ i : InvariantBasicOpenIndex ρ hU V,
            U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen i.1 := by
              congr 1
              funext i
              exact U.toSpecΓ_preimage_basicOpen i.1
    _ = U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (⨆ i : InvariantBasicOpenIndex ρ hU V, X.basicOpen i.1) :=
      (Scheme.Hom.preimage_iSup U.ι _).symm
    _ = U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V := by rw [ρ.iSup_invariantBasicOpen_eq hU hUa hVU hV]

/-- The quotient map of a stable affine chart is surjective on points. -/

    (hUa : IsAffineOpen U) :
    letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
    letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
    letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
    letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U

  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
  letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
  letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU

    (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso hUa.isoSpec.hom.base).2

quotient chart. -/
theorem quotientOpenOfStableSubopen_self [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (hUa : IsAffineOpen U) :
    letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
    letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
    letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
    letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
    letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU

  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
  letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
  letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
  apply Opens.ext
  apply Set.preimage_injective.mpr
    (stableAffineQuotientMap_surjective ρ hU hUa)
  change (↑((stableAffineQuotientMap ρ hU hUa) ⁻¹ᵁ
      quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ hU U) : Set U.toScheme) =
    (↑((stableAffineQuotientMap ρ hU hUa) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) : Set U.toScheme)
  rw [stableAffineQuotientMap_preimage_quotientOpen ρ hU hUa le_rfl hU]

the common-target identity used for triple overlaps in the quotient gluing
datum. -/
theorem quotientOpenOfStableSubopen_inf [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (hUa : IsAffineOpen U) {V W : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U) (hWU : W ≤ U)
    (hV : ρ.IsStableOpen V) (hW : ρ.IsStableOpen W) :
    letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
    letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
    letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
    letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
    letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
    quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ hU (V ⊓ W) =
      quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ hU V ⊓
        quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ hU W := by

  letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
  letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU

    intro γ
    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf, hV γ, hW γ]
  apply Opens.ext
  apply Set.preimage_injective.mpr
    (stableAffineQuotientMap_surjective ρ hU hUa)
  change (↑((stableAffineQuotientMap ρ hU hUa) ⁻¹ᵁ
      quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ hU (V ⊓ W)) : Set U.toScheme) =
    (↑((stableAffineQuotientMap ρ hU hUa) ⁻¹ᵁ
      (quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ hU V ⊓
        quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ hU W)) : Set U.toScheme)

    stableAffineQuotientMap_preimage_quotientOpen ρ hU hUa
      (le_trans inf_le_left hVU) hVW,
    stableAffineQuotientMap_preimage_quotientOpen ρ hU hUa hVU hV,
    stableAffineQuotientMap_preimage_quotientOpen ρ hU hUa hWU hW,
    Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]

/-- The quotient-open construction is monotone on stable subopens of a fixed
stable affine chart. -/
theorem quotientOpenOfStableSubopen_mono [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (hUa : IsAffineOpen U) {V W : X.Opens}
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (hWU : W ≤ U) (hVW : V ≤ W)
    (hV : ρ.IsStableOpen V) (hW : ρ.IsStableOpen W) :
    letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
    letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
    letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
    letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
    letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
    quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ hU V ≤
      quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ hU W := by
  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
  letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
  letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := stableAffineQuotientMap_surjective ρ hU hUa y
  have hxV : x ∈ U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V := by
    rw [← stableAffineQuotientMap_preimage_quotientOpen
      ρ hU hUa hVU hV]
    exact hy
  have hxW : x ∈ U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W := hVW hxV
  rw [← stableAffineQuotientMap_preimage_quotientOpen
    ρ hU hUa hWU hW] at hxW

Surjectivity upgrades `stableAffineQuotientMap_preimage_quotientOpen` from a
saturation statement to an image equality. -/
theorem stableAffineQuotientMap_image_stableSubopen [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (hUa : IsAffineOpen U) {V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (hV : ρ.IsStableOpen V) :
    letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
    letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
    letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
    letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
    letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
    (stableAffineQuotientMap ρ hU hUa).base ''
        ((U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V : U.toScheme.Opens) : Set U.toScheme) =
      (quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ hU V : Set _) := by
  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
  letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
  letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
  rw [← stableAffineQuotientMap_preimage_quotientOpen ρ hU hUa hVU hV]
  change (stableAffineQuotientMap ρ hU hUa).base ''
      ((stableAffineQuotientMap ρ hU hUa).base ⁻¹'
        (quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ hU V : Set _)) =
      (quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ hU V : Set _)
  exact Set.image_preimage_eq _ (ρ.stableAffineQuotientMap_surjective hU hUa)

/-- The image of a stable subopen under its affine invariant-ring quotient map is
open. -/
theorem isOpen_image_stableSubopen [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (hUa : IsAffineOpen U) {V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (hV : ρ.IsStableOpen V) :
    letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
    letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
    letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
    letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
    letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
    IsOpen ((stableAffineQuotientMap ρ hU hUa).base ''
      ((U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V : U.toScheme.Opens) : Set U.toScheme)) := by
  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction hU
  letI := sectionsAlgebra f U
  letI := sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f U
  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections hU
  rw [ρ.stableAffineQuotientMap_image_stableSubopen hU hUa hVU hV]
  exact (quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ hU V).2

    58	/-- **Finite prime avoidance in `Spec R`**: finitely many points of an open

    60	theorem exists_mem_basicOpen_le_of_finite {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    61	    (W : Opens (PrimeSpectrum R)) {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    62	    (p : ι → PrimeSpectrum R) (hp : ∀ i, p i ∈ W) :
    63	    ∃ f : R, (∀ i, p i ∈ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) ∧ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ W := by
    64	  classical
    65	  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (PrimeSpectrum.isOpen_iff (W : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))).mp W.2
    66	  have hWc : (W : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) = (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus c)ᶜ := by
    67	    rw [← hc, compl_compl]
    68	  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with
    69	  | inl h =>
    70	    refine ⟨0, fun i => (h.false i).elim, ?_⟩
    71	    rw [PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_zero]
    72	    exact bot_le
    73	  | inr h =>
    74	    cases nonempty_fintype ι
    75	    have hnle : ∀ i, ¬Ideal.span c ≤ (p i).asIdeal := by
    76	      intro i hle
    77	      have hpi : p i ∈ (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus c)ᶜ := by
    78	        rw [← hWc]
    79	        exact hp i
    80	      exact hpi ((PrimeSpectrum.mem_zeroLocus _ _).mpr (Ideal.span_le.mp hle))
    81	    obtain ⟨f, hfc, hf⟩ : ∃ f ∈ Ideal.span c, ∀ i, f ∉ (p i).asIdeal := by
    82	      by_contra habs
    83	      push Not at habs

    85	          ⋃ i ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset ι) : Set ι), ((p i).asIdeal : Set R) := by
    86	        intro f hf
    87	        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := habs f hf
    88	        exact Set.mem_biUnion (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_univ i)) hi
    89	      obtain ⟨i, -, hle⟩ := (Ideal.subset_union_prime h.some h.some
    90	        fun i _ _ _ => (p i).isPrime).mp hsub
    91	      exact hnle i hle
    92	    refine ⟨f, fun i => (PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen f (p i)).mpr (hf i), fun q hq => ?_⟩
    93	    have hq' : f ∉ q.asIdeal := (PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen f q).mp hq
    94	    rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, hWc]
    95	    intro hzl
    96	    exact hq' (Ideal.span_le.mpr ((PrimeSpectrum.mem_zeroLocus _ _).mp hzl) hfc)

   102	    (hU : IsAffineOpen U) {V : X.Opens} {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]

   125	/-- The orbit-in-affine hypothesis for a finite group acting on a scheme. -/

   129	/-- An open subscheme preserved by every element of the action. -/
   130	def IsStableOpen (U : X.Opens) : Prop :=
   131	  ∀ g : G, (act g).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U = U

   134	lemma act_one_hom : (act 1).hom = 𝟙 X := by
   135	  rw [map_one]
   136	  rfl

   139	lemma act_mul_hom (g t : G) :
   140	    (act (g * t)).hom = (act t).hom ≫ (act g).hom := by

   142	  rfl

   144	/-- If every orbit of a finite group action lies in an affine open, then every
   145	point has an affine open neighborhood preserved by the whole group. -/

   147	    ∃ U : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ IsStableOpen act U := by
   148	  classical

   151	  have horb : ∀ t g : G, (act g).hom.base ((act t).hom.base x) ∈ U.1 := by
   152	    intro t g
   153	    have hh : (act g).hom.base ((act t).hom.base x) =
   154	        (act (g * t)).hom.base x := by
   155	      rw [act_mul_hom act g t]
   156	      rfl
   157	    rw [hh]
   158	    exact hxU (g * t)
   159	  obtain ⟨s, hs_mem, hs_le⟩ := exists_basicOpen_le_of_finite U.2
   160	    (fun g : G => (act g).hom.base x) hxU
   161	    (V := Finset.univ.inf fun g : G => (act g).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
   162	    (fun t => mem_finset_inf.mpr fun g _ => horb t g)
   163	  have hWle : ∀ g : G,

   165	        (act g).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 :=
   166	    fun g => Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_univ g)

   168	    fun g => X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hWle g)).op ((act g).hom.app U.1 s) with ht
   169	  set N : Γ(X, Finset.univ.inf fun d : G => (act d).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) :=

   172	      (Finset.univ.inf fun d : G => (act d).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ⊓

   174	    intro g
